summary: Add opt-in warn-only pre-commit standard update action to reduce adoption churn

delivery.outcome: Repositories may opt into updates.action = warn-only in .governance/standard-adoption.json so pre-commit standard checks warn without aborting product commits, while preserving prepare-and-abort as the default and keeping malformed configs fail-closed.
nonGoals: Disable fail-closed validation on invalid standard-adoption.json configurations

architecture.decision: Extend governance/standard-adoption.schema.json updates.action enum with warn-only and teach scripts/precommit_standard_update.py to run read-only goal governance adopt --latest --check and exit 0 with a stderr warning when warn-only is configured.
interfaceChanges: Optional updates.action value warn-only in governance/standard-adoption.schema.json
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; existing prepare-and-abort configurations remain untouched.

validation.evidence: warn-only runs read-only check and exits 0 with warning on stderr for both goal and koru-goal, invalid actions still fail closed with exit 2, and default prepare-and-abort tests still pass.
Repository governance gate passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
